method: Manual comparison against public CurseForge and Modrinth result pages surfaced for Verity Pack, VERITY.exe, Falsity, monster-form, and broad Verity Mod searches. Download totals are point-in-time popularity signals, not safety verdicts.

modpacks.name: VERITY.exe
modpacks.sourceNote: Current CurseForge project route for VERITY.exe. Main file is Forge Port 2.1.2 for Minecraft 1.20.1, uploaded July 28, 2026; the older visible NeoForge 1.3.3 file is record 8385443, and the project description says voice chat and direct chat are supported while Groq issues are outside the pack author's control.

modpacks.name: VERITY.exe Remastered
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate Modrinth remastered modpack route inspired by the original VERITY.exe modpack. Treat it as its own MRPACK profile by ScootBuckley, not as the CurseForge VERITY.exe Project ID 1585389 route, not as Verity JE, and not as a Bedrock add-on.

modpacks.name: Verity Pack
modpacks.sourceNote: The public source text says this modpack does not contain the Verity mod and that the player needs to add it separately.

modpacks.name: VerityPack
modpacks.sourceNote: A separate CurseForge modpack route and not the same artifact as Verity JE or Bedrock add-ons.

modpacks.name: VerityPack Realistic
modpacks.sourceNote: A separate realistic CurseForge modpack route by felixdevytofficial; not proof that the standalone Verity JE file is installed.

modpacks.name: Survive from VERITY or FALSITY
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate CurseForge modpack route for users searching Verity or Falsity together. Treat it as a profile route, not as the standalone FALSITY [SMILEY] mod, Verity JE Java file, Verity BE, or PnTMC Bedrock file.

modpacks.name: Verity May Be
modpacks.mainFile: Verity May Be 1.3(The Brand New Lurkers).zip
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate horror modpack route that explicitly describes a small yellow ball that can talk and turns into a monster. Use it when the player wants that profile, not as the default standalone Verity JE file.

modpacks.name: VerityCraft
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate CurseForge horror profile that says Verity must be configured correctly before play. It can satisfy modpack gameplay intent, but it is not the standalone Verity JE JAR.

modpacks.name: Horror Ultimate Selection
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate horror modpack route that includes Verity AI setup in its description. Use it only when the player wants the whole modpack profile.

modpacks.name: Verity World - AI Horror Adventure with Verity
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate Forge profile route for an AI horror adventure with Verity wording. Current public source check shows Project ID 1598871, main file record 8473476, 44,641 project downloads, and 18.9K file downloads. Treat it as a modpack route, not a direct replacement for Verity JE, Verity BE, or PnTMC.

modpacks.name: Verity Endless Horror Experience
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate horror-experience modpack route that requires Verity to be configured before playing. Use it only when a user wants the whole profile.

modpacks.name: Verity + Factories
modpacks.mainFile: Verity And Create (Official Verity Mod) v0.4 BETA.zip
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate Create-plus-Verity profile. The source text says setup is needed because Verity connects to real AI, so do not treat it as a one-file standalone download.

routePolicy: Use modpack pages only when the player intentionally wants that profile. Use /falsity-mod/ for the standalone FALSITY [SMILEY] route, /verity-monster-form/ for monster-form and Body Overhaul confusion, Verity JE for the standalone Java Verity JAR, and Bedrock or MCPE pages for MCADDON routes. This site does not host or mirror files.
